quote: Except as otherwise provided in subsection 3 [NRS-484B-270-3], the driver of a motor vehicle shall not enter or proceed through an intersection while driving within a pathway or lane provided for bicycles, electric bicycles or electric scooters.

activation.condition: Driver of a motor vehicle enters or proceeds through an intersection while driving within a pathway or lane provided for bicycles, electric bicycles or electric scooters.

obligation.description: Do not enter or proceed through that intersection within the designated pathway or lane, subject to subsection 3.

exceptions.effect: Requires independent authoritative source review; no exception inference from route geometry.
exceptions.source_clause: Except as otherwise provided in subsection 3

timing.description: During intersection entry and passage with simultaneous vehicle-body occupation of the designated cycle facility.

parameter_refs.range_or_domain: reviewed public intersection and designated cycle-lane polygons

parameter_refs.range_or_domain: source-bound route crossing or avoiding cycle-lane overlap
